delivery_role_note: Official maps, pins, and optional geolocation help the public reach the current controlling official destination, but the map layer does not become the rule source by itself.
directions_service_policy_note: Directions links are travel helpers only. If they open an external service, keep the official site page available as the controlling election-information destination and clearly mark the external handoff.
geolocation_policy_note: Precise device location is optional and used only in-session to rank nearby official sites. Manual address, ZIP, and list views remain available.

map_entrypoints.label: Polling place and vote center map

privacy_minimization_note: Avoid storing raw coordinates, route histories, or address-search trails longer than the published policy requires. Do not bind public map behavior to voter records without a separately disclosed authority.
superseded_pin_behavior: Moved sites, changed entrances, temporary closures, and reroutes produce explicit pin updates, removals, or superseding notices instead of silent stale markers.
